title: Error occurs after using CompileModel node on macOS
body:
When I introduce the CompileModel node, the following error occurs when running a simple text2img process using flux on macOS:

```
...
  File "/opt/miniconda3/envs/comfyenv_py312/lib/python3.12/site-packages/torch/_inductor/codegen/mps.py", line 257, in dtype_to_str
    return DTYPE_TO_METAL[dtype]
           ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~^^^^^^^
torch._inductor.exc.InductorError: KeyError: torch.float64

Set TORCH_LOGS="+dynamo" and TORCHDYNAMO_VERBOSE=1 for more information
```

No issues if CompileModel is not used.

Here is the CompileModel configuration parameters:

```py
{
  "mode": "default",
  "backend": "inductor",
  "fullgraph": False,
  "dynamic": False
}
```
author: akuma

comments.body: Hi @akuma, it seems that the inductor backend failed in your macOS system. Just now, I added two additional backends——`eager` and `aot_eager`. Please update your ComfyUI-TeaCache node at first, then you can choose `eager` or `aot_eager` in `Comple Model` node to speedup.
Great! After using `eager`, it's running fine.

satisfaction_conditions: An alternative backend configuration that works on macOS
A solution that allows the CompileModel node to function without errors
A straightforward workaround that doesn't require complex troubleshooting

_classification.category: Requires build environment but hard to be dockerized
